title: Banks Act Directive D2/2024 — Reporting requirements in terms of regulation 46 of the Regulations relating to Banks
enablingLegislation: Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This directive is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Reporting requirements in terms of regulation 46 of the Regulations relating to Banks.

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This directive applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Reporting requirements in terms of regulation 46 of the Regulations relating to Banks.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Reporting requirements in terms of regulation 46 of the Regulations relating to Banks. Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This directive remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
